summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running any code, per the no-execution instruction, and nothing is committed. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); clickable_ranges support in renderables/underline_bar.py, which now yields one Text with click spans last; style-preserving blend in renderables/opacity.py; docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css; the required clickable-range test appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py; and a new tests/test_tabs.py. The layout resolver was left unchanged because its Edge protocol already has size, min_size, and fraction. Deviations to review: the bar position uses the displayed index rather than the full-list index so duplicate names land correctly; click actions are written as range_clicked('name') with repr quoting; first-character search only applies to single-character keys; activate_* methods are synchronous while action_range_clicked is async. The new and existing tests have not been run.
